capabilities: detect flashcards in notes using a Remnote-like format
expand brief card keywords into full content with OpenAI models
sync cards to Anki via AnkiConnect, adding new and updating existing cards
assign Anki decks automatically from file names
assign hierarchical tags from note headings
extras: Syncing requires configuring AnkiConnect's webCorsOriginList to allow app://obsidian.md and restarting Anki; AI enhancement can be disabled, making the OpenAI key optional.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create flashcards and sync them to Anki, and writing full, well-formatted cards by hand is slow.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses the AnkiConnect add-on for Anki
AI enhancement is currently powered by OpenAI's GPT-4o series

summary: Flashcard plugin that detects Remnote-style cards in notes, optionally expands them with OpenAI models, and syncs them to Anki via AnkiConnect.
